page_title: LEV 1-1 GIR | Levante v Girona 07/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: van de Beek D. Achilles Tendon Injury

commentary.text: 90+10' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+10' Luis Castro appears to have said too much and referee Guillermo Cuadra comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
90+8' What an opportunity! Vitor Reis (Girona) latches on to a perfect cross from the wing and produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes narrowly over the crossbar!
90+7' The main referee, Guillermo Cuadra, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Dela (Levante) is given a yellow card for dissent.
90+7' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Girona players have a reason to celebrate!
90+5' The Girona players halt their celebrations as referee Guillermo Cuadra makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

90+4' 1 - 1 Joel Roca (Girona) scores with a great individual effort! He makes a good run, skips past defenders and fires the ball from the edge of the box past the diving goalkeeper. His low drive went into the bottom left corner. Absolutely phenomenal!
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' What a chance that is! Axel Witsel (Girona) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass inside the box but is somehow only able to prod the ball onto the crossbar!
84' The resulting set piece from Girona is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

84' Joel Roca (Girona) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the roof of the net, but Mathew Ryan is alert and denies him with a nice save. The linesman points to the corner flag, Girona are going to take it.
80' Alan Matturro (Levante) powers a header just wide of the right post following a cross into the middle of the box.
79' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Manu Sanchez (Levante) is given a yellow card.
78' Luis Castro prepares a substitution. Oriol Rey is replaced by Unai Vencedor (Levante).
78' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Fran Cortes walks off the pitch to be replaced by Alan Matturro (Levante).
77' Vitor Reis (Girona) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
77' The attendance for today's match is 18552.
77' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
72' Michel has decided to make a change. Ivan Martin (Girona) replaces Fran Beltran.
72' That will be all from Thomas Lemar who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Abel Ruiz (Girona).
71' Joel Roca (Girona) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort.
68' Wasted effort! Kervin Arriaga (Levante) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range.
66' Mathew Ryan (Levante) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
66' We are about to witness a substitution. Karl Etta Eyong (Levante) is replacing Carlos Espi.
66' Here is a change. Ivan Romero is going off and Luis Castro gives the last tactical orders to Kervin Arriaga (Levante).
65' Mathew Ryan (Levante) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Arnau Martinez leaves the pitch and Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) comes on.
59' Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante) brings down his opponent with a horror tackle and receives a straight red card from the referee!
54' Michel decides to make a substitution. Hugo Rincon will be replaced by Alejandro Frances (Girona).
54' Substitution. Claudio Echeverri will be replaced by Joel Roca (Girona).

50' 1 - 0 A perfect lofted pass from Victor Garcia finds Carlos Espi (Levante), who jumps highest and steers a close-range header straight into the top right corner. His effort was both strong and precise, and Paulo Gazzaniga had no chance of stopping that. 1:0.

49' Fran Cortes (Levante) found himself in a promising position. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper was ready and made a decent save.
47' Girona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Levante take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
45' Dela (Levante) decides to have a shot at goal from the free kick, but it hits the defensive wall. Now Levante have a corner.

44' Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went low towards the middle of the target, but Paulo Gazzaniga was alert and the score remained the same.
36' Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) leaps like a salmon to meet a lofted ball into the box, but his header from near the penalty spot fizzes narrowly wide of the right post.
31' A big opportunity missed by Matias Moreno (Levante). He got on the ball inside the box and thumped a splendid first-time shot on goal, but it went narrowly wide of the right post.
30' Fran Beltran (Girona) attempts to score from a difficult angle on the edge of the box, but sends his effort narrowly wide of the left post.
26' A yellow card for a tackle by Hugo Rincon (Girona). Guillermo Cuadra doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
19' The corner is swung in but Levante can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

19' Fran Cortes (Levante) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the roof of the net, but Paulo Gazzaniga shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him. Levante have been awarded a corner kick.
18' Kareem Tunde (Levante) is substituted due to injury. Luis Castro gives a chance to Victor Garcia.
16' Kareem Tunde (Levante) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
13' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle and it's Manu Sanchez (Levante) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
9' Excellent touch by Kareem Tunde (Levante)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box but miskicks and the ball goes well wide of the right post. Poor effort.

5' Axel Witsel (Girona) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
5' The referee blows his whistle, Girona are awarded a corner kick.

3' A sweet pass finds Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the middle of the goal. Mathew Ryan is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
1' The match has just started.
Levante will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Guillermo Cuadra.
